name: Red Earth — Gate 2 Starter Shiny Contract
author: Adam M. Aguilera
description: Gate 2.10 starter shiny contract. Makes Oak-gift Fennekin and approved Grass starters genuinely shiny before the standard nickname UI, routes matching shiny battle/menu/icon art, shows shiny art in the native force-owned starter dex preview, and preserves shiny identity through evolution/save. Does not alter Irregular art, battle scale/grounding, starter selection, followers, Nature or passives.
